dataset: TUM VI calibrated room1 512x512 16-bit, EuRoC-format export
window: First 60 seconds from earliest exact-paired original camera timestamp, end exclusive, at most 1200 pairs
scope: External recorded real sensors only; no user hardware, LiDAR or physical navigation validation
calibration: Official 512x512 pinhole-equidistant camera-IMU calibration; cv2.fisheye.stereoRectify zero-disparity balance0 fov_scale1; rotate T_imu_camera into rectified optical frame
image_conversion: Fixed uint16 integer right shift8 to uint8, no adaptive contrast/exposure tuning
imu: Original publisher-calibrated 200Hz SI rows; first batch only available rows within20ms before first camera, then disjoint original causal rows; integer-ns clock subtraction before float conversion

imu_noise.source: Official TUM VI published inflated Kalibr noise values, not fitted here

metrics: rectification+image I/O+transport native pipeline wall latency
ATE: Only if actual calibrated ground-truth IMU frame and timestamp association verified; rigid SE3 alignment per native map, no scale fitting, report coverage and split maps; otherwise UNMEASURED
publication: Own compact derived metrics and calibration/source receipts; original dataset not republished
